new_facts_from_search: Apollo completed its ~$1.5B all-stock acquisition of parent Bridge Investment Group on 2025-09-02; Bridge keeps its brand and investment teams as an Apollo affiliate (https://www.nasdaq.com/press-release/apollo-completes-acquisition-bridge-investment-group-2025-09-02)

Bridge Logistics Value Fund II closed 2026-06-02 at nearly $1.4B vs $1B target; strategy is repositioning logistics assets in supply-constrained U.S. infill markets and global gateway cities, emphasizing off-market / selectively marketed deals (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/06/02/3305396/0/en/bridge-logistics-properties-raises-nearly-1-4-billion-for-its-value-fund-ii-exceeding-1-billion-target.html)

No 2025-2026 New Jersey acquisition by BLP found in public sources; most recent buys were Malden, MA (2025-Q1), 1.1M SF Fontana, CA (2025-11) and 768K SF Twinwood, TX (2026-06) (https://www.bridgeblp.com/post/blp-bulletin-q1-2025-recap ; https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20251118958022/en)

Linden Tremley Point purchase was financed with a reported $94.5M loan from Prudential Financial Insurance Co (https://www.costar.com/article/1530804556/bridge-logistics-expands-in-new-jersey-with-89-million-dual-warehouse-acquisition)

At 5 Plant Road, Hasbrouck Heights/Teterboro, BLP leased 24,267 SF to NAVAC for five years, bringing the 196,700 SF building to full occupancy, after renewing Skyline Windows and Direct Freight Express (87,000+ SF) (https://re-nj.com/bridge-logistics-hvac-manufacturer-sign-24000-sq-ft-industrial-lease-in-teterboro/ ; https://njbiz.com/north-central-jersey-industrial-sites-draw-leasing-activity/)
BLP operates from four regional offices (Northeast, West, Southeast, Central) (https://www.bridgeblp.com/)
Greg Boler's title on the firm's own site is Managing Director, East Region Investments (2022 newsletter) (https://www.bridgeblp.com/post/november-newsletter)
Will Gilkeson is listed by Traded as buyer-side on BLP deals into early 2026, supporting that he is still active; his current title is not confirmed (https://traded.co/investor/will-gilkeson)
Published buy box: $1-50M per deal (can go higher), Greater Northeast, industrial and conversion-to-industrial (office/lab/retail), deal feedback within 24 hours (https://www.velocityinv.com/focus)
Acquisitions lead: Will Riter, Director of Acquisitions & Leasing; Robert Fontanella, Associate Director; Keegan Skinner, Senior Associate Capital Markets (https://www.velocityinv.com/deal-team)
Founders' backgrounds: Zach Moore ex-Goldman Sachs IMD, Tony Grelli ex-Susquehanna Growth Equity, both Drexel (https://www.velocityinv.com/executive)

9000 River Rd, Pennsauken: ~560K SF bought 2022-01 for $32M from Aluminum Shapes in a Ch. 11 auction vs ~15 bidders; adjacent 8600 River Rd bought 2019 from the same seller; site now Pennsauken Logistics Center, 98% leased (https://re-nj.com/velocity-expands-footprint-in-pennsauken-with-purchase-of-560000-sq-ft-industrial-property/; https://montco.today/2022/01/bala-cynwyd-velocity-venture-partners/)

Lawrenceville 2572 Brunswick Pike $12.1M / 196K SF / 15.4 ac from Aurobindo without a broker confirmed; 110K SF of new leases (WORLDPAC, Express Logistics, iApparel) since (https://www.bisnow.com/news/philadelphia/industrial/velocity-venture-partners-south-jersey-industrial-acquisition-lawrenceville-120514; https://re-nj.com/velocity-adds-three-tenants-leases-110000-sq-ft-at-lawrenceville-industrial-building/)
Marlton East Stow Rd park is 160K SF, 5 buildings, rebranded Velocity Business Park and fully leased (https://re-nj.com/velocity-inks-three-flex-leases-for-40000-sq-ft-in-marlton-nai-mertz-says/)

Burlington Twp 1208 Columbus Rd: 33K SF addition completed for anchor tenant Specified Technologies (https://www.bisnow.com/philadelphia/news/industrial/exclusive-33k-sf-warehouse-addition-planned-for-burlington-township-industrial-building-127318)

Dispositions: 436 Commerce Lane, West Berlin, 48K SF sold for $4.2M under three years after purchase; stabilized Cherry Hill industrial exit via Binswanger (https://www.citybiz.co/article/375629/velocity-venture-partners-sells-industrial-property-in-west-berlin-new-jersey/; https://www.binswanger.com/binswanger-helps-velocity-venture-partners-exit-stabilized-industrial-property-in-cherry-hill-nj/)

2025 NJ activity is leasing not buying: Ambiont Biopallets 155K SF lease and Almag Aluminum 163K SF renewal at 9000 River Rd; 8600/9000 River Rd space marketed 2025-02 (https://re-nj.com/velocity-sustainable-packaging-firm-ink-155000-sq-ft-deal-to-fill-historic-pennsauken-building/; https://re-nj.com/velocity-venture-partners-aluminum-manufacturer-ink-163000-sq-ft-renewal-in-pennsauken/; https://www.bisnow.com/new-jersey/news/industrial/velocity-venture-partners-for-lease-pennsauken-logistics-center-industrial-studiob-127536)

No 2025-2026 NJ acquisition found; recent buys are in PA and include conversion plays: Colmar 340K SF $30.7M (2023-12), Richland Plaza retail, Quakertown $16.7M (2024-03), Sellersville $2M (https://montco.today/2023/12/velocity-venture-partners-colmar/; https://montco.today/2024/03/velocity-venture-partners-bala-cynwyd/; https://www.bisnow.com/philadelphia/news/industrial/sellersville-industrial-site-sells-for-2m-to-velocity-venture-partners-123545)
